description: This Dart source file defines an API client for interacting with a Todo backend service. It includes a class 'ApiClient' with methods for CRUD operations on todos, handles environment configuration for the API base URL, and provides error handling through a custom exception class. It also imports model class 'Todo' for data handling.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling HTTP errors with optional statusCode and message.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Singleton class providing methods to perform CRUD operations on todos via HTTP requests, with configuration for base URL and JSON headers.

methods.name: ApiClient.baseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL from environment variables or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: ApiClient._jsonHeaders
methods.description: Provides default headers for JSON content.

methods.name: ApiClient._uri
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object from a path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: ApiClient.listTodos
methods.description: Fetches a list of todos, optionally filtered by completion status, skip, and limit.

methods.name: ApiClient.createTodo
methods.description: Creates a new todo with provided details.

methods.name: ApiClient.updateTodo
methods.description: Updates an existing todo identified by id with new payload.

methods.name: ApiClient.deleteTodo
methods.description: Deletes a specific todo by ID.

methods.name: ApiClient.deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all todos, optionally with confirmation.

methods.name: ApiClient.getTodo
methods.description: Retrieves a single todo by ID.
